newsitem.title: UK: United says H1 in line with expectations.
newsitem.headline: United says H1 in line with expectations.

text.p: Britain's United News & Media Plc said on Wednesday that trading in the first six months of this year has been in line with expectations.
The media company told shareholders at the firm's annual meeting that it had experienced a strong performance across the group.
United also said that the impact of a strong pound on profits had been modest.
It said that television advertising revenues had been buoyant in the first half, but noted that Independent Television's (ITV) share had been affected by the launch of Channel 5 on March 30.
The ITV network groups 15 regional licensees, including the big three of Granada, Carlton and United News & Media.
The group also announced that circulation at its Express newspaper and at Exchange & Mart have stabilised.
